title: Sachin Sharma joins Hero Realty as Chief Legal Advisor
description: Sachin Sharma has been appointed as the Chief Legal Advisor at Hero Realty.A graduate of the University of Delhi, Sharma has over 22 years of post-qualification experience, with deep expertise in litigation strategy, insolvency resolution, structured finance, real estate transactions, capital markets, and regulatory compliance.
